title: Bar Salts Strawberry Ice Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Strawberry Ice flavour concentrate offers a cool twist on the classic strawberry flavour, featuring a hint of ice to enhance the summer berry sweetness. This 30ml bottle provides a delightful, crisp strawberry taste with a refreshing finish. This concentrate is designed for vapers who enjoy making their own e-liquids. Add it to a VG/PG base, tweak the nicotine strength with optional Nic Shots, and shake to create a personalized vape juice that’s both flavourful and satisfying. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
